description.en: A local read-only bridge to the QQArk archive daemon: query archived QQ group files, chat videos, and download tasks without leaving DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本机 QQ 群文件 / 聊天视频归档器的只读桥梁：在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查状态、群列表、已下载文件与下载任务。

description.en: Four read-only agent tools plus a sidebar panel that read your local QQArk archive over HTTP. Nothing is written back: the agent can only inspect status, group lists, archived files, and download tasks.
description.zh: 四个只读 agent 工具加一个侧边栏面板，通过 HTTP 读取本机 QQArk 归档器。不写回任何东西：agent 只能查询状态、群列表、已归档文件与下载任务。
